glosses: A secondary scale with finer graduations than the primary scale of a measuring device; the vernier measures between graduations of the larger scale.
A secondary control input with finer control than the primary, or coarse, input; for example the vernier frequency tuning knob on a radio.
A secondary system of force application for the attitude control of a spacecraft; for example a vernier thruster.

translations.source_sense_description: Messtechnik: Messgerät, um Innen-, Außen- oder Tiefenmaß zu nehmen

glosses: A type of sliding calipers for measuring the external or internal dimensions of objects, using the vernier scale for improved precision.

translations.source_sense_description: Messtechnik: Messgerät, um Innen-, Außen- oder Tiefenmaß zu nehmen

glosses: Instrument permettant de mesurer les longueurs, composé d’une règle fixe graduée en millimètres, et d’une partie coulissante.

examples.text: Le pied à coulisse est sans doute l’instrument de mesure dimensionnelle le plus largement répandu dans l’industrie.
